notes.title: Update 1.1.6
notes.content:
- Added the new Event.
- Added the Winner Crown icon in the background of the Bingo Calls menu to make more clear what this icon means. 
- Improved player data processing.
- Golden and Silver daub styles are now shiny!
- Fixed the Player Waiting Room not waiting for all game settings to be processed before going to Gameplay, which could cause errors.
- Fixed the Store zoom-in when switching item tabs being broken.
- Fixed the "Call Bingo Now!" text being covered by the End Game Timer.
- Fixed player cards sometimes showing the customization settings of other players.
- Fixed some parts of the Option panels not functioning properly or saving changes when closed.
- Changed the minimum Max Players setting from 1 to 2.
- The Host's own name, if they join as a player, is now coloured grey.

notes.title: November 6th, 2023 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch notes for November 6th, 2023 update 1.0.24:[/b]

[b]Client:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Added support for showing player follower status in-game. Followers' names in the Leaderboard are now shown in Follower Blue.
[*]  Fixed "Call Bingo Now!" text animation not looping smoothly
[*]  Fixed an error causing the game to sometimes lock up if ending the game early.
[*]  Fixed the Game History always starting out scrolled to the bottom of the list, instead of starting at the top.
[*]  Added "Winner" icon to the background of the Bingo Calls UI to make it more obvious what this icon means next to a player's name in the Leaderboard.
[/list]

[b]App:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added warning for when the player attempts to purchase an item while having insufficient funds to do so.
[*] Added a loading icon to the Scan Code button in the Event panel to show the user that the scanned code is processing.
[*] Improved performance of the QR Code Scanner.
[*] Fixed error caused by the Game End Timer still being considered "running" from a previous match.
[*] Fixed an error with device vibration sometimes causing Bingo calls to not be sent properly.
[*] Fixed some broken purchasing logic in the Store.
[*] Fixed event progress updates not being received. The progress bar will now update in real-time when the player earns a point.
[*] Fixed panels whose event has ended not disappearing, or causing the screen to bounce up and down.
[*] Fixed multiple event panels overlapping eachother in the case of multiple active events.
[*] Fixed Tooltips in Events panels going off the screen.
[*] Fixed the Event Progress value overlapping with the QR Code.
[*] Fixed the Event Progress value never showing up if the player had 0 event progress.
[*] Fixed the Event Time Remaining text displaying incorrectly when the event had passed its end time.
[/list]

notes.title: September 21st, 2023 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch notes for September 21st, 2023 update:

[b]Client:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed players getting multiple cards if the host started a rematch very quickly.
[*] Fixed the Leaderboard not properly comparing player entries until the host manually clicked on one of the sort headers.
[*] Fixed the new Previous Winner and Rank fields in the Leaderboard not being cleared when a player is removed from the list, or when switching modes.
[*] Fixed the Previous Winner icon not displaying properly.
[*] Fixed the Recent Games widget overlapping the App Download links with 5 entries.
[/list]

[b]App:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the card accuracy animation always showing every tile as wrong if the Ball - History Size was set to zero.
[*] Fixed store tabs being able to select items while a purchase was in progress for a different item.
[*] Fixed the number of Extra Bingo Card items not always updating.
[*] Fixed the number of auto-daub charges being cut off if the player had many charges.
[/list]

notes.title: August 16th, 2023 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch notes for August 16th, 2023 update:

[b]Client:[/b]
[list]
[*] The max number of Match Patterns has been increased from 15 -> 25.
[*] Added a brief timer before players can cancel creating a room. This is to prevent players from behaving maliciously by creating and cancelling rooms in very quick succession.
[*] Fixed bug where followed hosts would sometimes show as offline when they were actually online.
[*] Increased the login time limit, players now have much more time to complete the login process.
[/list]

[b]App:[/b]
[list]
[*] Match Pattern Indicators now show in two columns, to allow for clean display of up to 25 pattern indicators.
[*] Fixed several bugs related to network data from a rematch the player hadn't joined yet being processed in the background while still on the Endgame screen.
[*] Joining a game after Bingo has been called will now properly show the endgame timer to the player if it is running.
[*] Fixed bug where Match Pattern Indicators were not being properly cleaned up and could stack up.
[*] Fixed Max Ranked items in the Store showing an incorrect value in their XP Bar. The bar will now indicate that the item is at its current Max Rank.
[*] Increased the login time limit, players now have much more time to complete the login process.
[/list]
